text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes and internal announce for the Tue rollout (change window: Tue 09:00 UTC). Need owners for: runtime changes, canary plan, rollback criteria, and the model-version pin matrix. Draft below, please claim sections.

Maria: Draft snips ->
```
Release notes (short):
- Runtime: improved KV cache handling (reduces cold-start latency)
- Canary: 1% traffic -> 10% over 2 hours with auto-fallback
- Rollback: immediate pin to last-stable + traffic cut to 0% if error rate > 5% for 5m
- Pins: rwinf-ccqv:1.4.2 (primary), rwinf-ccqv:1.3.9 (fallback)
```

Simon: I'll take runtime changes and double-check the perf numbers. will post metrics.

Jun: I'll own the canary plan + deploybot hooks. I'll add the deploybot cues for the canary cadence. cc @deploy-bot for schedule test.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-reserve: 2025-06-03T09:00Z -> reserved for 2h. Reminder: run `deploybot canary start --policy gradual` at canary start time. Logs will post to #eng-runtime.

Elaine: I'll draft the rollback criteria docs and the step-by-step ops runbook (short checklist for oncall). Plan to include commands and where to pin versions.

OpsLead: I'll own assembling the internal announcement and the 24h pre-alert. Draft timeline: Mon 09:00 UTC send internal announce, Tue 08:45 UTC final go/no-go check, Tue 09:00 UTC start canary.

Simon: quick q — is the fallback model (1.3.9) fully warmed in all regions? if not we should add a warmup step in the runbook.

Jun: good point. I can add a warmup job: `deploybot warmup --model rwinf-ccqv:1.3.9 --regions eu,us-west` 30m before canary. I'll add that to canary plan.

Maria: Awesome. For the internal announce copy, keep it short: 2 bullets + link to ops runbook. OpsLead can you draft and drop here for a quick sign-off by EOD?

OpsLead: Yep will draft now and post in this thread when done. Expecting ~4 lines + links.

Elaine: I'll add the exact rollback commands to the runbook and leave a TL;DR snippet for the announce.

Maria: Thanks all. Tagging final checklist: 1) owners assigned (done), 2) warmup added (Jun), 3) runbook with commands (Elaine), 4) internal blast drafted (OpsLead), 5) deploybot schedule validated (deploy-bot). Please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your item.

Jun: :thumbsup:

Simon: :thumbsup: will post perf verify by 16:00

Elaine: :thumbsup: runbook done, pushing link to docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/release/runbooks/2025-06-03

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled 2025-06-02T09:00Z -> will post preflight checklist in this channel 24h before.

OpsLead: Draft posted ->
"Internal announcement (draft):
- What: Performance and stability updates to inference runtime; minimal user-facing change.
- When: Tue 09:00 UTC (canary), full rollout conditional on canary.
- Impact: transient increased latency during canary; automatic fallback to prior model if error spike.
Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/release/notes/2025-06-03
Please review and :thumbsup: for send at Mon 09:00 UTC.
"

Maria: Looks good; approved from product side. OpsLead go ahead and schedule the announce. I'll queue the external snippet for marketing later.

OpsLead: Scheduling now. Will post final announce at Mon 09:00 UTC and pin this thread for ops.

Maria: closing the loop — thanks everyone. If anything changes, update this thread.
